verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents threshold-based Triggers and SLO burn alerts, with notifications routed to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or custom webhooks that use templated JSON payloads. That covers alerting and routing. Nothing in the evidence covers grouping, deduplication or silencing/muting of notifications, and alerting on every signal type (metrics vs. traces vs. logs) is implied rather than stated. Missing for 10: notification grouping/deduplication, silencing/muting or maintenance windows, explicit documentation that triggers work across all signal types, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: Use triggers to send alerts when thresholds that you define and configure are passed.
Set up Triggers and SLOs to alert your team when conditions are met, and route notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or a custom webhook.
Route Honeycomb Trigger and SLO burn alerts to any service that accepts a JSON payload, including third-party tools and custom integrations.
